description: This Java source file defines the DebugXaResource class, which extends GenericXaResource to provide debugging capabilities for XA transactions. It includes methods for commit, rollback, enlist, and logging transaction identifiers, primarily used for debugging and tracing XA transaction states.

classes.name: DebugXaResource
classes.description: A debugging extension of GenericXaResource that tracks and logs XA transaction actions for troubleshooting purposes.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Handles the commit of a transaction, removing the Xid from the debug resource map and logging verbose information if enabled.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Handles the rollback of a transaction, removing the Xid from the debug resource map and logging verbose information if enabled.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists the resource in the current transaction, associating it with the Xid in the debug resource map.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs the current Xid and exception information for debugging purposes.
